trigger.script: Run the collector, normalize row-level results through scripts/checklist_engine.py with explicit plan/profile/target-scope/capabilities, then run scripts/inspection_gate.py with the same selection inputs. Return fire=true only when the gate result contains llm_required=true; pass only run_id and evidence_bundle to the Agent. Treat registry validation failure, prohibited checks, missing time range, malformed JSON, or any non-zero exit as a failed inspection, not as healthy.

payload.message: Read the gated evidence bundle. Validate evidence and provide only the required interpretation or escalation. Do not recollect routine healthy metrics.
